name: raw-bank-file-load-exclusive-save
source:
Reserve As Work 4,4
Bload "in",4
Bsave "out",Start(4) To Start(4)+3
Print Peek(Start(4)+3)

encoding.notes: Literal Bload=180c, Bsave=181a, Reserve As Work=20f2, Start=0140, Peek=21e6 and existing expression words, independently framed without the production encoder/table.

evidence.notes: Bload transfers a raw whole file into an existing bank/address; Bsave writes end-start bytes, excluding the end address. Source-derived expected bytes, not an Amiga capture.
